examples.english: The Supreme Court is scheduled to hold oral arguments on this case next month.

notes:
Composed of {弁|べん} (speech) and {論|ろん} (argument/discussion). Has two main usage contexts: (1) in law, where {口頭|こうとう}{弁論|べんろん} (oral argument) refers to formal proceedings in court, and (2) in education, where {弁論|べんろん}{大会|たいかい} (speech contest/debate tournament) is a common school event.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口頭|こうとう}{弁論|べんろん}: oral argument (legal)
- {弁論|べんろん}{大会|たいかい}: speech contest, debate tournament
- {弁論|べんろん}を{開|ひら}く: to hold oral arguments
- {弁論|べんろん}{術|じゅつ}: art of rhetoric/debate
- {最終|さいしゅう}{弁論|べんろん}: closing argument

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ディベート: debate — loanword, refers specifically to competitive structured debate
- {討論|とうろん}: discussion, debate — broader term for formal discussions
- {演説|えんぜつ}: speech, address — one-directional public speaking, not back-and-forth
